ORDINANCE Aen | 17, 2024

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols

and indications as shown on Map No. 26-F in the area bounded by
The alley next north of and parallel to West 110th Street;
South Wentworth Avenue;

a line 86.0 feet north of and parallel to West 110th Street;

and a fine 43.10 feet west of and parallef to South Wentworth Avenue.

to those of a B2-1 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due

publication.

Common Address of Property: 10950 South Wentworth Avenue
